subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose announceTarget through both sessions_spawn and global/per-agent configuration, with parent routing suppressing channel delivery and failing closed when the requester cannot be awakened?
rationale: Implementation correctness cannot decide a permanent public tool, configuration, persistence, session-wakeup, and delivery-fallback contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow to per-spawn first
options.body: Sponsor explicit caller-selected routing but remove global and per-agent defaults until persistent policy has demonstrated need.

options.title: Approve the full contract
options.body: Accept the additive tool and configuration surfaces, channel default, persisted routing, and no-channel-fallback parent behavior.

options.title: Defer native routing
options.body: Keep current channel completion behavior and callback workflows while the orchestration policy is redesigned.

recommendation.title: Narrow to per-spawn first
recommendation.body: Sponsor explicit caller-selected routing but remove global and per-agent defaults until persistent policy has demonstrated need.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work crosses the spawn, session-handoff, and announce lifecycle surfaces involved in this product decision.
